purpose: Human-reviewed evidence only. Never populate floor_count from a generic height estimate. Each record must identify the exact OSM feature and provide a stable HTTPS source, evidence type, reviewer, date, and explanation.
verification_requirements: Use osm_id exactly as indexed, such as way/12345.
Count visible storeys carefully; record roof levels separately when evidence supports it.
Use an official plan/profile, licensed imagery with a clear full-building view, owner-provided documentation, or field survey.
Do not use estimated height alone as independent floor evidence.
Do not mark a building verified if the image hides storeys or the image-to-building match is uncertain.
Keep evidence source, license, attribution, reviewer and review date with each accepted record.
